BA.rationale: Boeing's fundamental health is poor: the company has not produced a profitable quarter in the available sample, with Q2-2026 net income of -$428M and operating margin collapsing to 0.6% despite record revenue of $24.56B. The balance sheet remains fragile with debt-to-equity of 7.456x and liabilities at 96.3% of assets, even after the equity swing from -$3.3B to +$6.1B. Valuation is extremely stretched at 71.4x trailing P/E with a 1.4% earnings yield versus a 4.68% risk-free rate — a -328bp spread that prices in a recovery the income statement has not delivered. The qualitative franchise ($715B backlog, duopoly position) is real but execution risk remains high: commercial airplanes are unprofitable (-2.7% margin), 777X certification is delayed, a $700M DOJ payment is due in Q3, and first-half FCF is still negative at -$823M. The market has priced a turnaround that the numbers do not yet confirm, creating downside risk if execution falters on any of multiple fronts.
key_factors: Q2-2026 net income -$428M; no profitable quarter in the 4-quarter sample (Q1-25: -$31M, Q2-25: -$612M, Q1-26: -$7M, Q2-26: -$428M)
Operating margin collapsed to 0.6% in Q2-2026 from 2.0% in Q1-2026 despite 10.5% QoQ revenue growth — cost-of-revenue grew faster than sales
71.4x trailing P/E with 1.4% earnings yield vs 4.68% 10-year Treasury yield (-328bp spread) — deeply unattractive on relative basis
Debt-to-equity 7.456x; total liabilities $159.75B are 96.3% of total assets $165.87B; equity cushion of $6.12B is thin
Commercial Airplanes segment unprofitable at -2.7% operating margin; defense swung to -0.2% margin due to $280M VC-25B loss
First-half 2026 FCF still negative at -$823M; $700M DOJ payment due Q3 2026; 777X certification potentially delayed into late 2020s
FAA restored self-certification authority July 20, 2026 — positive but execution credibility gap remains after years of operational failures
Record $715B backlog and duopoly position provide long-duration structural value, but gap between backlog promise and proven cash conversion is the central tension
